requirement_breaks: If `_advanceToNextUp(self)` finds no initialized tick before a non-initialized `self.endTick` that is exactly the last tick in a bitmap word, this `reset` leaves `self.currentTick == self.endTick`, so `hasNext()` becomes true and `getNext()` can return `self.endTick` even though it is not initialized, violating the requirement to return only the needed initialized ticks and no others.
